nearest.reopen_condition: A retry needs materially new evidence such as forward replacement-value rows, a real-time breadth persistence field, or a production-visible catalyst/flow provenance layer. Pure OHLCV threshold retunes should stay frozen.

A retry requires independent PIT confirmation with adequate historical coverage, such as borrow pressure, options structure, ownership, or event/news context, or closed forward replacement-value rows under a shared default-off adapter.
If revisited, use forward replacement-value rows or a materially new free-data source such as official short-interest/ownership context; do not just retune OBV or close-location thresholds.

Next useful evidence is a shared default-off helper that reproduces this exact historical replay and daily snapshot semantics, plus closed forward replacement-value rows. A production/live activation would need a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4 with capital caps, liquidity and slippage assumptions, exposure limits, displacement, and kill switch rules.

sentinel_target_price_contract.reason: This observed-only runner consumes already closed target-trade artifacts and does not regenerate signals or backtester exits; target_price is therefore not used as a strategy signal contract in this attribution.

gate3.note: No filter is applied to strategy behavior; survival measures ATR join coverage.

gate4.acceptance_rule: Require >=150 usable rows, >=20 per canonical window, aggregate coarse-minus-small tick return delta > 0, and at least two windows plus two source families with positive coarse-minus-small tick return delta.

production_impact.parity_note: This runner reads historical target-trade artifacts and warehouse OHLCV only. It does not alter production/backtest adapters or any order path.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The fixed tick-to-ATR field was joined at entry time across three existing short-trend candidate artifacts. The result is judged only as attribution: aggregate and cross-window coarse-minus-small tick return deltas must agree before the field can be treated as a future lead.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not rerun this by changing ATR lookback, tertile cutoffs, momentum thresholds, source top-N, hold days, cooldowns, notional, or response shape on the same artifacts. A legal retry needs a genuinely new microstructure source such as PIT spread/depth, materially more closed forward rows, or a shared helper Gate 1-4 that preserves this exact field contract.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: PIT spread/depth or cost data, materially more settled forward rows, or a shared default-off helper with standard Gate 1-4.
